# SD13-E5 Ranger level 2 hybrid chassis baseline fixture.
# Represents a deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Ranger level 2 identity as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity
# values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and
# bonus-feat) and stays a single-class, level-2 hybrid baseline, mirroring the
# level-1 fixture's shape with the class level swapped.
#
# The SD13-E5 level-2 widening adds two new deterministic choice selections that only
# apply at the 2nd-level Combat Style Feat gate: `choice:ranger_combat_style` (the
# archery-vs-two-weapon-combat style choice PF1 grants at 2nd level) and
# `choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat` (the first bonus feat drawn from that
# style's own restricted list, granted together with the style choice at the same
# level). This fixture selects Archery and Point-Blank Shot, the archery style's
# 2nd-level restricted list's first alphabetical-by-table entry after Far Shot
# (verified against legacy.aonprd.com's Core Rulebook Ranger Combat Style Feat
# entry). It deliberately avoids every later hybrid burden surface still out of
# scope: no spell selections, no spells known/prepared posture, no favored-terrain
# breadth, no animal companion, no tracking-engine accounting, and no bonus-feat
# mechanical execution (Point-Blank Shot's own attack/damage bonus is not computed
# anywhere in this codebase).
case_id=pf1-crb-human-ranger-level2
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:ranger:2
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:8
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:survival:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:strength
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy:enemy:humanoid_orc
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style:style:archery
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat:feat:point_blank_shot
